timing.replay: The archived entry regenerates the measured native timing host. Its read-only stage and weathering snapshot runs after the first ready frame, before the captured warm-up and RAF intervals.
timing.nativeExitReason: preview-host exits 1 when renderOk && transportClean is false. Three canceled network requests make transportClean false. FPS and p95 gates are reported separately per route.

limits: Still images freeze both scene clocks to 14 and hide the HUD. Frame intervals come from a separate animated session.
These RAF intervals cover render submissions and browser scheduling on this RTX 3060 Laptop. Walking uses native held-W input and is separate from the four fixed camera measurements.
C now includes R1 rear alley props. D is a physically composed camera at the town lane, whose background city mesh has no player navigation surface.
